results.title: Nevada football Fan Fest set Aug. 8 at Mackay Stadium
results.description: Nevada Athletics will host its annual Football Fan Fest from 5-7 p.m. Saturday, Aug. 8, at Mackay Stadium. Fans may enter the Fan Fest through Jensen Plaza, located on the northwest point of Mackay Stadium.

results.title: ‘That’s nuts!’: Aussie sprint king and queen crowned as records tumble in Comm Games epics
results.description: Lachlan Kennedy and Torrie Lewis broke the national records and finished on the podium in a thrilling night for Australian sprinting on a wet track at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
